# @fyit/crouton-pages

> CMS-like page management with page types from app packages, tree/sortable layout, public rendering, and custom domain support.

AI hint: use when app has CMS pages or landing pages

## Components

- `CroutonPagesBlockContent`: Block-based content display
- `CroutonPagesEditorBlockEditor`: Block-based page editor
- `CroutonPagesEditorBlockEditorWithPreview`: Block page editor with a live preview panel
- `CroutonPagesPublicPage`: Public page view (fetch, SEO, render) shared by both public routes
- `CroutonPagesRegularContent`: Rich text content display
- `CroutonPagesRenderer`: Renders page based on type

Props, events and slots: [components.md](components.md)

## Composables

- `useDomainContext`
- `useNavigation`
- `usePageBlocks`
- `usePageTypes`
